nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Micellar Cleansing Water

avis.texte: rlly good for acne prone skin- tried others and broke me out but this one doesn't!
Cleans my face and neck, leaving it moisturized without feeling abrasive.

Purchased this religously for a while. Ouldnt find it on the shelves for a couple of months so I was excited to see it on the shelf again! Unfortunately this is not the same as what i used to buy. Strong fragrence which isnt terrible but the real killer is how badly it burns your eyes. You're unable to remove your macsara without your eyes instantly burning. Dont waste your money!
anyone complaining about the smell is very sensitive to smells!! If thats you, i wouldnt use it. I had my whole family smell it and everyone agreed the smell wasnt bad at all!
it does a good job at removing makeup but makes my eyes burn unfortunately

I have repurchased multiple times as it was my holy grail makeup remover. However when I purchased last momth and used it, there seemed to be a strong frangrance and it left a burning sensation on my skin. It left me with rashy irriated skin for days. Sadly removing this one from my routine
Why does it need a synthetic fragrance? It also leaves a slimy, sticky film on my face and breaks my skin out. I'll stick with Bioderma.
It doesn't separate like other brands. Feels clean and fresh. I enjoy using it as a second cleanse.

avis.titre: The best makeup remover for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: For starters, I am 43, I have very sensitive skin, rosacea, acne- everything! This doesn't irritate my skin and it does what it claims. Great product.
really wanted to love this but its so heavily fragrenced…it does good job at removing makeup though. really refreshing as a light morning cleanse. unfortunately won't repurchase due to the fragrence.

I bought my first bottle and the remover worked great, used the whole bottle. Replaced it and now it doesn't work? I haven't changed my makeup routine but my new bottle is leaving residue and stinging my eyes. Can't remove my eyeliner or mascara without going through 4-6 cotton pads

avis.titre: Best Micellar Water On The Market
avis.texte: It will work well for any skin type. I have oil, super sensitive skin and some acne. Super gentle, doesn't leave your face oil and no fragrance. Does not irritate skin at all. Removes dirt and make-up! You won't be disappointed!

avis.titre: works great but don't get it in ur mouth
avis.texte: genuinely ive accidentally gotten it in my mouth a couple times and the taste is so awful. also it burns my eyes a lot. definitely removes makeup but at what cost

My dermatologist recommended this to me when i was a teenager & i still come back to this now as an adult! Its just all around a good micellar water- I never break out with it, it cleans my face without over-stripping, takes off makeup, you get a good amount. I typically use this in mornings alone when my skin is drier or at night as a first makeup cleanse. I only wish it was fragrance free but to me it still isnt a strong or harsh scent.

It does what a micellar water is supposed to do. However, I try to buy skincare products that have no fragrance. I was hopeful because this one says it is meant for sensitive skin. It definitely has a lingering fragrance. I usually use the "Simple" brand micellar water, and will be going back to my old faithful immediately.
Wanted to like this, removed my eye makeup fently and effectively. Caused acne to flair up, whether product was left on or cleansed off skin.

Theres no need to waste your money on other micellar water because this is the one you need. I literally was taking off my eyeshadow & i put it on for 5 secs & everything was already gone. I have senstive skin so i have to be careful with cleansing right if now ill have a pimple the next day. Spend your bucks on this one🤍
THIS IS MY FAVORITE PART OF MY SKINCARE ROUTINE. It hold moisture in pretty well.

avis.titre: Smaller bottle and NOT cruelty free
avis.texte: It works but upon receiving my last order I noticed that the bottle was smaller. So was the bottle of serum. Another greedy CEO ripping off the consumer! Also found out LRP products are tested on animals!! For these reasons I will no longer use these products.
I love this product, the only negative i have found with it is it sometimes irritates me eyes after using it 6/7 days a week.

avis.titre: Not rinsing flares acne prone skin
avis.texte: Despite saying it is non-rinse, for people with acne prone skin, this is not best practice. My skin has been acne free with my current regimen and I added the micellar water per reviews on IG. I have had the WORST break out my skin has seen in ages. I've worked so hard to find a good regimen for my aging skin only to now look like a teenager again with horrible acne. I have since read that if you have acne prone skin you SHOULD rinse it because it leaves a barrier on the skin which blocks oil productions, clogging pores.

Can you please make this product without fragrance? I love la roche posay and would undoubtedly purchase this on repeat if it was formulated without fragrance. I have to use the CeraVe micellar water since it has no fragrance but I so much would rather purchasing from your brand. I use many other LRP fragrance free products. I have very sensitive skin and I really believe there's no usefulness with having fragrances in products in general but especially ones that are marketed for sensitive skin. Please consider. Thanks.

I used to use the discontinued item from it cosmetics called miracle water and ive missed it so much! Well, this is a really good alternative to it. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and hydrated without leaving it feeling oily/greasy. I cant go a day without using it or i feel my skin is missing something.
This removed my stubborn mascara in a flash! I also like the smell, it reminds me of bananas
So clean!!!! After using the cleaner my next step is following up with the Micellar Water ultra. I'm always left with a really clean feeling skin and my skin looks so refreshed.
"I really liked it at first, and it was effective in removing my waterproof mascara. However, it started causing my lashes to come off when I used it."

I've been consistently using this particular product for a number of years now, primarily drawn to its remarkable ability to treat my skin with a gentle touch while effectively and thoroughly removing makeup. One aspect that further enhances its appeal is the fact that it is entirely devoid of any scent, ensuring a pleasant and unobtrusive experience every time I use it.

avis.titre: It is good enough to try
avis.texte: I use this one for almost 5years,so i found out that i found what is suite for my sénitive skin,it makes you feel cool on your face when you apply and not hot or dry later
Love ! How my face feels so soft and clean, am going to keep use it and see how it works. I also love the fresh smell really light smell

This is the second time I've bought a product from Ulta based on the ingredients listed, only to find the actual product ingredients are worse. This micellar water contains BHT and a fungal acne trigger called polysorbate 80.
I use makeup remover, cleanse, cleanse AGAIN, and then use this micellar water and my cotton pad still has residue on it. This stuff if GOOD! Gets all the extra grime and then some. I love it.

Fragrance is just too strong. La Roche should know better than to have this strong of fragrance added for a sensitive skin care product. Very disappointed. I'd love to purchase one for "Reactive skin" which is fragrance free…I purchased it overseas and love it so I thought the one for "sensitive skin" would be same but boy was I wrong! So why is one for reactive skin not on your site??

I have been using this product in my night time routine for over a year already. I love how it makes my skin feel and I love how it removes all left over make up. I use an oil cleanser and then use this to remove any excess make up. It's super gentle to my skin and eye area. Does not dry my skin. I love how they have a bigger size now with a pump! Definitely recommend this product.
I love Thai products, very easy to use and goes on clean. Feels fresh and easy to apply. No mess to clean up after. Quick and easy process. Leave you feeling fresh and clean.
This is what I use to remove makeup before I wash my face. I love the feel on my skin. Sometimes, I use it for a quick face cleanse. Does not dry me out.
This is the only micellar water that I use to clean my face of makeup because it is made in a country I trust.

avis.titre: Perfect lotion to remove make up
avis.texte: Wonderful lotion to remove all make up in the evening. I love the way it feels, cleans, and its delicate scent.
I can't use most regular makeup remover due to rosacea and this is the most wonderful thing I have found

I had been using Garnier which is quite good but wanted to try another line and I very satisfied with this. I am a senior citizen with minimal dryness and this product is very gentle on the eyes and face. There is a very very light fragrance to it which is very calming, not irritating to the senses. I use L'oreal Telescopic mascara which can be hard to remove, so I always do a double swipe.

avis.titre: LA ROCHE POSAY MICELLAR WATER ULTRA
avis.texte: My skin is sensitive and acne prone and this product has really been a game changer for my skin care routine. This product is gentle and never irritated my skin.

I literally can't buy anything that's not loaded with perfume! No wonder people need prescription excels eczema meds! It's in makeup shampoo lotion body wash laundry detergent! You can't make a cleaners without fragrance!! READ THE REVIEWS!
I have sensitive skin and eyes and this micellar water works great! I've repurchased and plan on repurchasing again once I run out

The fragrance in this makeup remover is very strong and it made my skin very dry, itchy, and sensitive around my eyes. I also developed little bumps on the top of my cheeks. The brand is so well reviewed I thought I would love this product. I will be sticking to garnier or cleansing balms.

DO NOT USE ON YOUR EYES!!! I repeat do not use on your eyes to remove any makeup! "This no rinse micellar water" has fragrance and it burns even after washing it off and washing my face and throwing copious amounts of water on my eyes and using a tissue to dry my eyes they burn and are extremely red and irritated! This is not safe for your eyes! Please take out the fragrance there is no need for it! I love all their other products except this one.
The fragrance smell is too much for me. I cannot use this product. Some of the best dermatologists say Skincare products should not have fragrances in them

I am so disappointed. I could not read the ingredient label in the store, (white printing on clear bottle) so I foolishly assumed this product was safe for my sensitive skin. Now my face is burning and I wish I could start my day again.

I am a big fan of LRP products and this one is a staple in my (and everyone I know) facial care routine. I do have dry/combination skin type and I do feel that this product is gentle and effective on my skin. I do not use this product to remove my make up but rather to clean any residue, dirty, oils after ive used a face wipe. If you think your face is clean, use this on a cotton round and you'll be completely disgusted by how much dirt is on your face. I also used this to touch up any make up fall out on my skin after ive done my make up and it looks perfect. This water is gentle for anyone dealing with sensitive skin or conditions like rosacea. I will be purchasing again and recommending to everyone.

avis.titre: It's not as good as Garnier
avis.texte: The OG Garnier Micellar water still beats this one ever single time. HOWEVER - this is definitely a runner up.
This is such a nice cleanser! Leaves skin soft and hydrated. I wear very little makeup, typically a tinted sunscreen and some eyeliner, and this dissolves these with ease. Great product!

I do not like the very perfumed scent. It's not great at removing heavy or waterproof makeup. I also find the dispenser hole at the top also to be annoying - it always spills out more product than I intend. I guess that's ok since it will help me blow through this product quicker and I can just be done with it. Lots of waste though. Thought I might like it the same as, if not more than the trusty Bioderma Sensibio micellar water because I do use & love a few other products by this brand. But this micellar water is a miss.

This product does get rid of the makeup and cleanses the skin. However, in the ingredients, it lists fragrance. Fragrance is a broad term that could include toxic chemicals. There have been responses that it is a "mild scent". If so, then please tell us what ingredients are in this fragrance instead of keeping it a secret because that is worry some if there are harmful chemicals in this product. It has been two years and people have been commenting about the fragrance, yet they have not done anything about it!
honestly it's my second night using this product but I already love it! I love all la roche posay products!!!
this stuff removes makeup well but makes my eyes BURN so bad i'm literally crying while typing this
Clean & simple. Can be used as a gentle second cleanser / makeup remover or toner. Great ingredients, pricing, and lots of product. I'll definitely be purchasing this again
Doesn't remove all makeup, especially eye makeup. it's very expensive for not doing it's job and has fragrance. It burns my eyes bad.
Such a light, clean, refreshing product. I feel so rejuvenated after using this. I have very sensitive skin, but this doesn't flare up my redness or cause burning. I LOVE it.
This should not include fragrance since it is marketed for sensitive skin.

I have rosacea so my skin is very sensitive and reactive. This was recommended to me by my pharmacist in France. I was hesitant to use it at first just because other micellar waters didn't work for me, but I'm so glad I did. I either use it on its own or as the first step of a double cleanse on days that I wear extra sunscreen and/or tinted moisturizer. When I use it on its own, I usually spritz my face with thermal water and pat dry, or give it a light rinse from the faucet. But I know people who don't rinse it off at all. Do whatever works best fo your skin type. In any case, it's amazing stuff. It cleans well and feels wonderful!

avis.titre: This toner is the best toner
avis.texte: The product is great. smell is very good. I feel my skin glow and smooth sbd clean when i use it. I buy three of them for future usage. I love la roche posay

I've used quite a number of miscellaneous water in my time and this is by far the best. Leaves your skin feeling clean without stripping it and you leaves some glow to your skin due to the hydrating factor as well. I use this as the last step of my cleansing routine and more often than not don't need to mist up because my skin is completely saturated from this product.

I've watched the sell of these products at the store I work at. I was always curious if it would work for my daughter and I. I'm so glad that I finally purchased it. It leaves our face refreshed, clean and removes our makeup without harshness!

avis.titre: Very happy that I bough this
avis.texte: I have a sensitive skin, i was looking for something gentle yet good enough to remove my make up or just as one more step before applying my routing. My skin reacted very well, i been using for over 2 weeks

Words cannot accurately convey my love for this micellar water. It has a lovely fresh smell and does not leave my dry skin feeling stripped, I absolutely hate the garnier ones. So good and lasts forever!

Apply on a disposable facial cotton pad (NOT cotton pads), swipe my face & neck twice. Cleans well, WITHOUT any tightness & dry feeling. I love the fragrance it has!! Skin is still good without moisturizer. Sensitive Combination/oily. Using for sometime.
Really great and easy to use, I would recommend using it with a makeup cloth, it's easier and takes less product to clear makeup off yours face.
I'll use this probably forever. It does have a fragrance, but I do like fragrances (sorry). It's definitely a higher-end dept store toner fragrance. Great results as well.
This makes my skin feel smooth and soft! I have super dry skin but this makes my skin feel great afterward! It does a great job of removing most of my makeup!
I had no idea this would have such a strong fragrance! It's a shame bc it seemed nice otherwise

Strong fragrance, harsh on sensitive skin. I usually use a micellar water before a cleanser to take off makeup. I was out of the one I regularly use and decided to try this. Well, that was a mistake. It was super harsh and I felt like it was stripping the oil from my skin. My face was as red as a tomato after. Would not recommend and won't be repurchasing. Giving it two stars because I like other products from this line and hope it gets improved. Also hope my review doesn't get taken down since I gave it a low rating.
Excellent product ! Good micellar water to take off my make up, gently and soft for my sensitive skin

avis.titre: Gentle clean and the bottle lasts forever
avis.texte: This micellar water is very gentle with no fragrance so it would work well for sensitive skin. I use it to remove light make up for daily like sunscreen and powder. It wouldn't remove full make up nor mascara/eyeshadow. This bottle would last me forever. Nothing is too impressive so I don't think I would buy it again. So 7.5/10
This is an amazing formula for sensitive skin I really love this brand. Very light, does not leave the face greasy or sticky. You can see the good quality and it feels fresh.
Powerful for removing makeup and gentle around the eyes to remove eye makeup. Just love it. It works fabulous!

Takes makeup off but you have to use 2-3 cotton pads, so you're wasting product. Also doesn't take off mascara(have to go over it maybe 4 times ). It smells good and doesn't break me out but will not be repurchasing

Unfortunately I think this product is causing my skin to turn red and burn. I have sensitive skin and I used this as makeup remover and then continued with my skincare routine. My two new products was this and the lipikar face cleanser. And the burning and redness is out of control. I noticed the red started with using this product.
I recently switched from garnier to this one and I absolutely love it. It's gentle and smells great in my opinion. I have sensitive skin and this Does not bother it at all
Makes my skin so plump and goes well with my other skincare products.

I started using this when I realized that I hated makeup wipes. This micellar water takes off all of my makeup and doesn't leave any weird film or feeling on my face afterwards. You get a lot of it for your money and it is middle of the road as far as price goes. Every time I run out and have to use another brand until I replenish, I always remember why I like it so much. I have oily-combo skin for reference.

My skin is oily, sensitive, and acne-prone. I have many closed comedones and do get cysts from time to time especially along my jawline. The jawline area tends to get super dry easily (peeling, flaking) if I overdo a product or use a product that's too strong. I've tried several micellar waters for my skin and it's always a longer process to get my long-wear foundation off. This product is definitely more efficient and really pulls the makeup out of your skin without irritating or over-drying. I cannot speak for the mascara removal as I only use one product to remove my mascara due to extremely sensitive eyes, so I have not even tried to use this on my eyes in fear of them getting irritated. Bonus: it smells very lightly of crisp, sweet Bartlett pears. Seems to be the best makeup remover for my oily, acne prone skin - no residual makeup so no whiteheads/blackheads/cysts etc. Great product!

I love this brand of beauty care. I bought this after using garnier miscellar water and having redness with it. I love how gentle it is on my skin, even when I wipe my eyes. There's no redness and no burning. My face feels clean after using this, it feels like it's removed all of my makeup.

I tried many and this is the best micellar water ever. Removes stubborn makeup but never burns my sensitive eyes. The bottle lasted a long time so it's a good value for the excellent quality. This one will be the one I will repurchase from now on

I love this! I've been looking for a good makeup remover that doesn't irritate my eyes, is affordable, and that a little goes a long way and this is it!!!! It's so worth and and so far this brand hasn't failed me at all!
this is what my face needs, blends perfectly with my skin type. would definetly recomand

I have a huge problem with clogged pores, I get blackheads all the time. I use this as a final step after cleansing with facewash and I've noticed the clogged pores significantly decrease, without drying out my skin. I've spent years trying to figure out the right combination for me, only to have skin too dry, too sensitive, or just stuff that plain doesn't work. This has been a crucial step in my new routine.
I use this as a daily cleanser. It's very gentle, doesn't require rinsing, doesn't leave a residue, and doesn't cause me to breakout. It's a good value compared to similar products.
Fav makeup remover applicator. Second time repurchasing this product.

I've read other reviews saying this stings eyes…. I have had the opposite experience! This is one of the first makeup removers ive found that DOES NOT sting my eyes! I've tried makeup wipes, balms, and other micellar water type products and this one is so gentle! I swipe right over my eyes with a cotton round and it comes right off! No rubbing, no burning or stinging eyes! I will continue to buy :)

There is fragrance in this, I will not be repurchasing this product. When skin care companies put fragrance in there facial care products it really makes me feel like I can't trust using their products.
I bought this because it said it was for sensitive skin and removed eye make up. It does that but every time it stings and makes my eyes red... Not so great.
I use this whenever I need to clean my face after a long day. It smells good and has similarities to a good toner!

avis.titre: Not for people with sensitive eyes
avis.texte: I usually use Bioderma since I have sensitive eyes but I ran out. I decided to try this brand's water while I was at Ulta since I love so many of their other products. This was a mistake. My eyes have been very red and irritated for over 24 hours and when I used it my face broke out in hives. I did see mentions of a reformulation so maybe it was because of that.
I'm on bottle #2 or 3 now and it's an okay product. Good for sensitive skin but doesn't really feel like my face is clean or helps with breakouts. Currently looking for a replacement 😕

I use micellar water as the first step in cleaning my face when I have sunscreen or makeup. It takes off that first layer. Then I use CeraVe SA cleanser to remove any remaining residue. I use a separate eye makeup remover.

This is the first time using Micellar Cleansing Water, and I thought I would be safe using a sensitive formula from a reputable brand like La Roche-Posay. However, I was left EXTREMELY disappointed. The first time I used it to remove eye makeup, not only did the skin around my eyes burn, but so did my eyes. My eyes burned so bad that I could barely keep one of them open for about 45 minutes. Did some research and realized I may have used too much, fair. Used it again, and I will say my eyes didn't burn, but the skin around my eyes still did. And it didn't even remove all my eye makeup. So, I will be returning this today and finding something better.
Cleans the skin of all dirt and oil. Leaves the face refreshed snd glowing.
I was so excited to try this after reading all the reviews but I ended up being highly allergic. My face was so itchy; it broke out in hives and bumps after two uses. I returned it.
I like this brand but, for me, nothing beats the Garnier or Bioderma micellar water. I've tried this once. It was OK but not good enough to make me switch.

I've tried other micellar cleansing waters and this one is by far the best. When I've used other brands, I would have to rub harder causing redness on my skin and lost eyelashes. With LRP's, you can be super gentle on your face and eyes and it takes all of your makeup off effortlessly!
Only used once so far but I instantly loved it! No greasy film afterwards and can be used in the morning for a quick wash if in a rush

I have never used Miscellar Water before using this product, and now I'm hooked. What's great about this product is it really does clean your skin and take off any make up or impurities, while being gentle and leaving your skin soft and hydrated. ￼

This product surprised me! I decided to try this out after a bad breakout from the clinique Take the Day off cleansing balm. This micellar water removed all of my makeup except some stubborn waterproof mascara. I also never leave makeup-removing products on my skin; **I always go in with another cleanser after removing makeup. Even doing this step, the clinique cleansing balm severely clogged my pores

Bought this product as a replacement for a discontinued product and was very disappointed. It has a very strong fragrance (not good for sensitive skin as the bottle says..), and left makeup residue all over my face. It honestly felt like I may as well have just splashed my face with water. It also left my skin feeling dry and tight. Would absolutely not recommend this product to anyone who has dry or sensitive skin.

A lot of micellar waters make my skin freak out but this one is very gentle i love it. Super gentle and takes makeup off soooo easily. My face always feels very calm and hydrated after using it. Also very good to use in the mornings instead of face wash if you're in a rush.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This micellar water is very gentle, doesn't irritate or dry out my sensitive skin, I'm happy with result.
I love this to remove my makeup or just to take off the excess of products of my face before washing it. I don't feel like it irritates my eyes
Removes makeup very easily and does not irritate my sensitive oily skin.

This removed my makeup as well as any other micellar water. However, I was unpleasantly surprised by the strong floral fragrance in a product advertised specifically for sensitive skin. The fragrance has a very strong floral sent. I would continue using this product if it were fragrance free.
great product...easy packaging that doesn't leave any to waste! doesn't leave you feeling greasy & definitely makes your skin feel cleaner. smell is not bad either.
okay i LIKE this, i do. it's one of ulta's better micellar waters. it just smells like the makeup counter at younkers, remember younkers? and not in a good way. in a weird old lady way.
